name: essentials
description: Productivity utilities with auto-rename, shell aliases, lazy loading, hooks system, and cross-platform support

features.lazy_loading: Skills loaded on-demand with lazy_load frontmatter
features.cross_platform: Windows (PowerShell, cmd), macOS (Bash, Zsh), Linux (Bash, Zsh)
features.auto_rename: Intelligent session renaming with Action: Context format
features.shell_aliases: cc (normal) and ccc (bypass) aliases for Claude Code
